rca of the issue: Original RCA from iteration_34 confirmed and resolved. Fix at /app/frontend/app/admin/blog/import/page.tsx:361-377 — uploadOneImage now maps file extension (.webp/.jpg/.jpeg/.png/.gif) to a MIME type and wraps the raw JSZip Blob in `new File([blob], fileName, { type: mime })` before appending to FormData. The browser now sends Content-Type 'image/webp' for the file part, satisfying the backend's allowed-mime list. End-to-end verified.
